introduction: Explore Arachdrathos’s web, houses, market and guilds; understand the gatekeeper’s key request and the separate city services.
orientation: Llzazan’s main road, eastern approach and overlook connect to the city. The Descent also has a current reciprocal route. Discovery follows actual admitted arrival, rather than a view, travel message or map display.

Ask the gatekeeper hi, hello or door for one greeting about the private-room key. The native purchase costs 10 platinum, issues a new key and retires the gatekeeper. Greeting aliases do not each complete a quest.

This coin-only key purchase is currently unavailable while accounting is active. A recorded purchase stays separate from the current key and door state. This service awards no achievement or daily quest credit.

The gatekeeper also carries a key. Recovering that copy from its source, receiving a supplied copy and obtaining the purchase reward are different histories. Possession alone cannot prove an accepted purchase.

From Slaver’s Paradise, the private door leads south into the Pleasure Room. The reverse exit is north, despite that room’s prose saying west. It starts locked and resists picking; the matching key, unlocking, opening and successful crossing are separate.
Both city-gate pairs start open under their native resets. Their declared second key does not make it a required initial-entry puzzle. Preserve current gate state and admission when travelling.
The keys have native NORENT flags. Physical key retention through logout differs from a durably recorded accepted receipt. A remembered purchase does not supply a missing current key.
The six houses have separate entrances in the Arachdrathos Guilds area. Their seals are wearable insignia. Carrying or wearing a seal, visiting a house and earning a lasting allegiance are separate.

The barkeep offers generated world quests under native level, quota, fee and target rules. Use quest to see a current task. A target conversation or credited kills, the delivered reward and the gatekeeper’s request belong to different progress.

The Body Traders uses adjacent holding-room stock for its native service. New purchases and pet rentals are unavailable while accounting is active. Encountering a captive or hireling does not record liberation or safe arrival.

The banker’s coin-exchange advice differs from a bank transaction. The visible counter supports native bank commands and a separate locker entrance under current admission. Reading contracts or ledgers does not complete an investigation.
The archives, fountain, furnace, market, crossbows, disguise kits and teachers suggest wider stories. Actual admitted learning, crafting, item use and recipient outcomes need their own evidence.

The city’s wind, void, damaged webs and cavefisher repairs are narrative leads. They do not by themselves define a fall, a mandatory flight ability or a completed restoration. Pool traversal still uses native water admission.
House intrigue, captive illithid treatment, slave release, religious choices and civic restoration need builder-defined prerequisites and lasting outcomes before they can award completion.

stories.title: The gatekeeper’s private-room key
stories.summary: The gatekeeper asks 10 platinum for a key and leaves after accepting the purchase. Coin-only settlement is currently unavailable while accounting is active. The accepted purchase and later door access are separate.

steps.text: Record the gatekeeper’s accepted key purchase
steps.hint: The native request costs 10 platinum, issues a new private-room key and retires the giver. It currently refuses offerings while accounting is active. Only an accepted receipt records this purchase; a greeting, wallet balance, keeper-carried key, supplied key, unlocked door or room entry cannot replace it.
